messages.author: James Kress
messages.body:
Is there any tutorial or descriptive process I can use to build a DNA
oligomer with a 5-methylcytosine modification that will work in AMBER?  I've
searched the AMBER website, the list archives and the web but cannot find a
descriptive process for building this entity.
Any help would be appreciated.
Thanks.

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Nov 25, 2024, James Kress via AMBER wrote:
>Is there any tutorial or descriptive process I can use to build a DNA
>oligomer with a 5-methylcytosine modification that will work in AMBER?  I've
>searched the AMBER website, the list archives and the web but cannot find a
>descriptive process for building this entity.
All kinds of modified DNA and RNA nucleotides (including 5-methylcytosine)
are covered in the recently released libXNA project:
https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.4c01164
There happens to be a 5-methylcyotosine specific tutorial(!):
https://modxna.chpc.utah.edu/duplex-with-methylated-cytosine/
..good luck...dac
